services.desc: Our morning session focuses on warm up, stroke production, drills, tennis footwork, and games. Boys and girls between the ages of 5 and 16 are welcome to join our fun filled camp. Beginners will learn fundamentals of grips, stroke patterns, timing, scoring, basic tennis movement, and hand-eye coordination.
